BiblicalUsage: hôwlêlûwth is the word for folly. It appears in Ecclesiastes, and each time it carries that same plain sense.
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hôwlêlûwth I do not force more than it gives: folly.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
